title: Quality Engineer III
description:
**About Team**
 The Health \& Wellness Engineering team at Walmart is on a mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and convenient for millions of customers across the US. We build the technology that powers Walmart's pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and wellness platforms spanning prescription management, clinical workflows, patient\-facing digital experiences, and health program delivery. Our systems process millions of prescriptions annually and connect patients, pharmacists, prescribers, and payers in real time. The team operates at the intersection of technology and healthcare, building platforms that have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and community health.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Quality Engineer III for Walmart Health \& Wellness, you'll have the opportunity to:
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and test suites that validate the quality, reliability, and compliance of Walmart's pharmacy and health platforms
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and clinical stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, test strategies, and quality gates across the SDLC
   

  

 Build and execute end\-to\-end, integration, regression, and API test suites for critical healthcare workflows including prescription processing, patient data management, and clinical integrations
   

  

 Ensure all test coverage adheres to HIPAA compliance requirements and that test environments handle sensitive patient health information (ePHI) with appropriate data masking and privacy controls
   

  

 Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality validation and fast feedback loops for development teams
   

  

 Perform thorough defect analysis, document bugs with precision, and work closely with engineers to drive timely resolution of issues
   

  

 Contribute to shift\-left quality practices — participate in design reviews, requirement grooming, and early\-stage risk identification to prevent defects before they reach production
   

  

 Adhere to Company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 BE/B Tech/ME/MTech in Computer Science or related technical field
   

  

 Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in software quality engineering with a focus on test automation
   

  

 Test Automation — Java Stack — Proficiency in Java for building and maintaining automation frameworks; TestNG / JUnit 5, Selenium WebDriver with Page Object Model (POM), Maven / Gradle
   

  

 API Test Automation — Hands\-on experience with REST Assured and Postman / Newman; validating JSON / XML responses, status codes, schema validation, and end\-to\-end API workflow testing
   

  

 BDD \& Test Design — Cucumber \+ Gherkin for behaviour\-driven test design; feature file authoring, step definition mapping, and data\-driven test strategies
   

  

 CI/CD Integration — Embedding test suites in Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Concord pipelines; parallel test execution, test reporting (Allure / ExtentReports), and quality gate enforcement
   

  

 Database Validation — SQL proficiency for test data setup, teardown, and result verification; experience with PostgreSQL / MySQL and basic NoSQL awareness
   

  

 Healthcare Domain Awareness — Understanding of HIPAA compliance, PHI / ePHI data handling in test environments, and familiarity with healthcare workflows (prescription lifecycle, clinical data, payer integrations) is a strong advantage
   

  

 Engineering Fundamentals — OOP basics, Git branching strategies, code reviews, defect lifecycle management, and test documentation practices
   

  

 Soft Skills — Analytical and detail\-oriented mindset, precise defect reporting, collaborative, strong ownership of quality outcomes
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Flexible, hybrid work
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
   

  

 Equal opportunity employer
   

  

 Walmart, inc., is an equal opportunities employer – by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people

title: Wireless Systems Test Engineer (WLAN & Edge AI)
description:

title: Application Development Group Manager - Senior Vice President
description:
**Role Overview:**
 We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on Lead Forward Deployed Engineer in Chennai to act as an evangelist for continuous integration, testing, and safe, automated deployments and to coordinate the activities of the regionally deployed FDE team. This is a practical DevOps and SRE role for a practitioner who leads by example to make change safe and easy for development teams. The position is roughly 70% coding and configuration.

* Perform hands\-on work including, but not limited to:
* Wrapping the application in a suite of well\-designed tests, most of which can run locally, including smoke tests to be run as part of the deployment process.
* Sourcing and integrating appropriate test data, implementing data masking in lower environments
* Upgrading to supported runtimes (generally Java or NPM).
* Containerizing applications where feasible.
* Upgrading open\-source libraries to their latest available major versions (e.g., migrating from Spring 2\). Upgrading to the latest version of all dependencies, whether installed software, libraries, internal code, base images or operating system. Implementing processes that allow us seamlessly to stay current
* Implementing continuous library updates using Renovate.
* Introducing best practice source control and branch management
* Improving code review processes
* Ensuring best practice security patterns, secrets management, authentication and authorisation
* Simplifying and automating application deployment processes, including automated database changes with Liquibase and installed software with Ansible.
* Introducing standard observability patterns.
* Overhauling exception handling and logging.
* Implementing resilient hot\-hot cross\-datacenter deployment topologies.


**Required Qualifications**
* Several years of experience with Test\-Driven Development (TDD) using multiple test frameworks.
* Really excellent understanding of the different approaches to automation testing and an ability to choose the best approach and drive outcomes with AI support
* Proficiency in JVM languages and optionally TypeScript.
* Highest quality coding skills
* An excellent understanding of safe practices for critical systems, including deployment architecture and observability
* At home with multiple continuous integration and deployment systems
* Excellent understanding of secure coding practices
* Competent with Docker and Openshift
* Actively embracing AI coding
* Comfortable with build automation tools such as Gradle, Maven, and npm.
* Competent with (RedHat) Linux
* Spring framework skills are advantageous.
* Ansible skills are advantageous


**Recommended Qualifications:**
* 12\+ years of relevant experience
* Experience in applications development
* Experience in management
* Experience managing global technology teams
* Working knowledge of industry practices and standards
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

title: Infrastructure Test Engineering Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 You will be a member of Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering and contribute to performance engineering, scalability validation, and reliability assurance for applications and infrastructure platforms. This role partners with engineering domains, application development teams, DevSecOps, service delivery, and operational support teams to validate application behavior under expected, peak, stress, endurance, and failover conditions.
   

  

 The Performance Test Engineer will work in a rapid development environment as part of a multi\-disciplinary engineering team that designs, develops, evaluates, tests, verifies, validates, and supports performance testing solutions. The role requires hands\-on experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, Fiddler, and related monitoring/analysis tools. The candidate should be able to design workload models, build performance scripts, execute load and stress tests, analyze bottlenecks, and provide actionable recommendations. General understanding of infrastructure testing concepts such as Linux/Windows, network connectivity, firewalls, proxies, load balancers, cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD automation is preferred.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Develop understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery process, Performance Test Engineering framework, CoE (Center of Excellence) Engagement process as well as understanding of tech\-stack (tools and technologies) to perform day\-to\-day job
* Prepare, maintain and execute performance test scenarios based on non\-functional requirements and follow standard DTCC testing guidelines
* Automate performance test scenarios by leveraging current automated functional and performance test scripts
* Support traceability across Non\-Functional Requirements, Performance Test Scenarios and Defects
* Support the review of performance test scenarios from both a technical and business perspective with stakeholders, such as development teams and business
* Track defects to closure, report test results, continuously execute plan and escalate as required
* Support integration of performance testing with Delivery Pipeline and produce results
* Create synthetic test data as per the data distribution and volume requirements
* Develop a understanding of the product being delivered
* Adhere to all process standards, guidelines and documented procedures
* Develop an understanding of the logical architecture and technical design of the supported application in relation to the performance and scalability
* Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Develop understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery process, Performance Test Engineering framework, CoE (Center of Excellence) Engagement process as well as understanding of tech\-stack (tools and technologies) to perform day\-to\-day job
* Prepare, maintain and execute performance test scenarios based on non\-functional requirements and follow standard DTCC testing guidelines
* Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected.
* Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up\-to\-date.
* Collaborates well within and across teams.
* Communicates openly with team members and others.
* Resolves disagreements between colleagues effectively, minimizing the impact on the wider team.

title: Security Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
 As a Security Automation Engineer I, you will contribute to the growth and maturity of our Security Operations team by developing and maintaining automation playbooks and workflows within our SOAR and XDR platforms. You will be responsible for translating analyst\-driven investigation workflows into automation that accelerates triage, enrichment, containment, and remediation of issues across the SOC. A strong background in security operations is essential for this role. Understanding what happens before and after an alert is received is what separates functional automation from automation that reflects how real investigations work. By collaborating closely with SOC analysts and senior engineers, you will help reduce manual workload, improve response consistency, and support a more resilient security operation.
   

  

**Experience**
 2\+ years of experience as a SOC analyst, with senior analyst experience preferred. Candidates must demonstrate hands\-on familiarity with alert triage, threat investigation, and escalation decision\-making.
   

  

 1\-2 years of experience working with a SOAR platform, with Palo Alto XSIAM or XSOAR experience strongly preferred.
   

  

**Education**
 Four\-year college degree resulting in a bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Certifications, Accreditations, Licenses**
**One Or More Of The Following Certifications**
 Palo Alto Cortex, CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA CySA\+, GIAC GSEC, EC\-Council CEH, and similar.
   

  

**Special Knowledge**
 The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, common attack techniques, and SOC operational workflows. Candidate will have experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, endpoint protection, and email security technologies. Familiarity with SOAR playbook development is required, with Palo Alto XSIAM and/or XSOAR experience being strongly preferred. Candidates should understand common detection use cases including phishing, endpoint compromise, identity threats, and network anomalies.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python for scripting and automation tasks is required. Candidates must be comfortable working with REST APIs, Regex, and JSON to build and troubleshoot platform integrations. Familiarity with Windows, MacOS, and Linux environments is expected.
   

  

**Skills**
 Develop, test, and maintain automated playbooks and integrations across Palo Alto XSOAR and Cortex XSIAM. Collaborate with SOC analysts to identify manual, repetitive workflows and translate them into reliable automation. Experience integrating security tools and platforms to support cohesive, automated response workflows.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills to evaluate playbook performance, identify logic gaps, and iterate based on analyst feedback and operational data. Effective problem\-solving to troubleshoot integration and automation failures.
   

  

 Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document playbook logic and contribute to design discussions across distributed teams.
   

  

**Abilities**
 Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and stay productive in a remote environment. Must be a collaborative team player capable of contributing to technical conversations and troubleshooting sessions. High attention to detail to ensure automation logic performs accurately under varied conditions.
   

  

 Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving threats, detection techniques, and automation capabilities. Ability to adapt playbook logic as the threat landscape and tool stack change over time.

**Job Description**

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**




 Jitterbit is a market\-leading Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) \& API Management solution provider recognized in Gartner MQ for seven straight years. We help businesses make faster and more effective decisions by making it fast, easy, and cost\-effective to seamlessly connect their data, apps, and devices. Do you have the quality\-driven initiative to lead validation and testing efforts on our products and take on this challenge?
   

  





**What you will be doing:**




 Jitterbit is seeking a SDET Engineer who is smart, curious, and loves the challenge of solving problems that improve the testing feedback loop. You'll collaborate with an agile team to architect, implement, and continuously deliver the testing tools and infrastructure required to run tests at scale for both our front\-end and back\-end components. You'll be using the latest from Node, Webdriver.io, and Typescript or from pytest and Python to accomplish these goals. You will also work with our DevOps team to integrate tests into our CI/CD pipeline using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Selenium Grid, Docker, and other similar technologies. You will also be exposed to a lot of different end\-user endpoints we are supporting from MS Sql Server/MySQL/Oracle/MongoDB, to MS Dynamics CRM/Salesforce/NetSuite, and other technology endpoints such as REST/SOAP/FTP/HTTP/XML etc.
   

  





 We believe in approaching our automated testing efforts just like any other software development effort. That's why we're not just writing tests, we're building test software and reporting solutions that help our developers continuously deliver new features and products to our customers. Like keeping up with the latest trends and technologies in automated testing? Great! You'll be expected to do that and much more. We want someone who isn't afraid to experiment and bring new ideas to the table. You should be self\-educating and self\-motivated through curiosity, a passion for quality, and an unruly desire to squash software bugs dead in their tracks. Come help us re\-imagine our solutions to provide an integration platform that delights our customers and improves the performance of a world\-class engineering team.
   

  





  

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

* **Impact Through Automation** 
 – A proven track record of thoughtfully transforming manual test coverage into maintainable, high\-value automated test suites — balancing speed, reliability, and long\-term sustainability.
* **Modern Testing Ecosystem Expertise** 
 – Strong experience with modern frameworks and tools such as Node.js, Angular, WebdriverIO, Jasmine/Mocha, Selenium, or PyTest (or comparable technologies). You understand how to select the right tool for the right problem.
* **Strong Programming Foundations** 
 – Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or similar languages, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production\-quality test code.
* **Agile Quality Mindset** 
 – Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments as an embedded Quality Engineer who influences design, improves testability, and helps teams deliver with confidence — not just at the end, but throughout the lifecycle.
* **Cloud \& SaaS Testing Experience** 
 – Exposure to iPaaS, SaaS, or other cloud\-based platforms. You understand distributed systems, integrations, and the complexity of validating them.
* **API \& Integration Depth** 
 – Hands\-on experience testing APIs (REST/SOAP), working with JSON/XML payloads, and validating integrations with relational databases, CRM/ERP systems, and third\-party platforms.
* **Tooling \& CI/CD Fluency** 
 – Comfortable working with tools such as Postman, Jenkins, Docker, VirtualBox/Hyper\-V, npm/yarn, JMeter, JIRA, GitHub, and related DevOps toolchains to support continuous testing.
* **AI\-Enhanced Productivity** 
 – Experience leveraging AI tools to improve test generation, code quality, analysis, or productivity — and curiosity to continue exploring what’s possible.
* **Technical Curiosity** 
 – Comfortable reading vendor API documentation and independently navigating complex integration landscapes.
* **Remote Collaboration Excellence**

* **Communication \& Influence**

* **Flexibility \& Ownership**

**Additional Information**

* During design, critical thinking helps choose between potential solutions or design patterns. It ensures thoughtful decisions that impact the overall system.

 **QA Automation Architect**

 The successful candidate will be responsible for architecting and implementing end\-to\-end mobile automation solutions, incorporating AI\-powered testing capabilities, and establishing best practices for quality engineering. This position does not include people management responsibilities and is ideal for someone who enjoys owning technical solutions from concept through execution.

**Mobile Test Automation Architecture** 



* Design, develop, and maintain a robust mobile automation framework supporting both iOS and Android platforms.
* Build scalable automation solutions leveraging Appium, TestNG, Cucumber, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement shift\-left and shift\-right testing strategies to enhance quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Establish reusable automation components, coding standards, framework governance, and quality metrics.



**AI\-Driven Quality Engineering** 



* Develop and integrate AI\-enabled testing capabilities to improve efficiency, coverage, and reliability.
* Implement AI and LLM\-based solutions for automated test case generation, intelligent test execution, and mobile app validation.
* Drive innovation in areas such as visual testing, anomaly detection, behavioral change analysis, and predictive quality insights.

* Build advanced automation capabilities including Self\-healing mobile element locators
* AI\-assisted test data generation
* Automated test case authoring

* Embed automated testing within CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI or Jenkins.
* Enable continuous testing through automated quality gates and real\-time reporting mechanisms.
* Support parallel execution across multiple device types, operating system versions, simulators, emulators, and cloud\-based device farms.
* Ensure rapid feedback loops and measurable quality outcomes throughout the release lifecycle.



**Technical Ownership \& Enablement** 



* Serve as the subject matter expert and owner of the automation framework.

* Partner with engineering teams to encourage framework adoption and continuous improvement.
* Provide technical mentorship and consultation without direct people management responsibilities.

* At least 3 to 4 years of experience designing and implementing enterprise\-grade mobile automation frameworks.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
description:
TechGrove is the
 **Centre of Excellence** 
 for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 



 About Element34
   

 Element34 is building modern enterprise solutions for software quality and test automation. Our
   

 flagship product, SBOX, helps enterprises run their Selenium, Playwright and Appium tests
   

 securely within their own infrastructure, behind their firewall and within their security and
   

 compliance boundaries.
 



  

 We are part of Banyan Software, a long\-term owner of profitable vertical software businesses.
   

 Element34 operates with a lean engineering organization, giving engineers the opportunity to
   

 work closely with product, customers and leadership and see the direct impact of their work.
 



 About SBOX
   

 SBOX is an enterprise test automation platform that enables organizations to run browser and
   

 mobile automation at scale within their own environment.
   

 The platform supports Selenium, Playwright and Appium and includes capabilities around test
   

 execution, browser/device management, reporting, integrations and AI\-powered quality
   

 capabilities.
   

 We are continuing to evolve SBOX into a more AI\-native quality engineering platform, making
   

 reliability, automation intelligence and actionable quality insights an important part of the
   

 product.
 



 The Opportunity
   

 We are looking for a SDET / Quality Engineer who wants to play a key role in building the next
   

 generation of quality engineering for SBOX.
   

 As our product and engineering velocity grow, we want to make quality an integral part of how we
   

 build and release software — not something that happens only at the end of the development
   

 cycle.
   

 You will help us build stronger automation, improve regression confidence, identify quality risks
   

 earlier and create better ways of understanding and resolving failures.
   

 This is a high\-ownership engineering role. You will have the freedom to identify opportunities,
   

 propose solutions and take them from idea to implementation.
   

 You won't just be executing predefined test cases — you'll help shape how quality engineering
   

 works at SBOX.
 



 What You'll Work On
   

 Automation \& Quality Engineering
   

 ● Design, build and maintain robust automation for critical SBOX workflows.
   

 ● Develop automation using Playwright, Appium and Selenium.
   

 ● Translate product requirements, user stories and customer workflows into meaningful
   

 automated scenarios.
   

 ● Build reusable automation components and frameworks that scale with the product.
   

 ● Continuously improve regression coverage and test reliability.
   

 Test Execution \& Failure Analysis
   

 ● Build and maintain automated workflows that run reliably in CI and unattended
   

 environments.
   

 ● Work with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or equivalent.
   

 ● Analyze test results and investigate failures across application, automation, infrastructure
   

 and environment.
   

 ● Debug failures deeply and drive them through to resolution.
   

 ● Identify and eliminate flaky tests and recurring sources of instability.
   

 Quality Strategy
   

 ● Partner with engineers and product managers early in the development lifecycle.
   

 ● Help define the right testing strategy for new features and major product initiatives.
   

 ● Identify edge cases, integration risks and potential regression areas.
   

 ● Contribute to release\-readiness decisions using meaningful quality signals.
   

 ● Continuously improve our automation architecture, testing practices and tooling.
   

 Test Management \& Defect Management
   

 ● Create and maintain test cases, workflows and regression suites.
   

 ● Track execution progress and manage defects through their lifecycle.
   

 ● Participate in defect triaging and collaborate with Engineering and Product teams.
   

 ● Improve visibility into automation health, product quality and release confidence.
 



 What We're Looking For
   

 Must Have
   

 ● Strong experience in SDET, QA Automation or Quality Engineering.
   

 ● Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright and Appium
   

 ● Experience with Real\-device/mobile testing
   

 ● Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or another programming
   

 language.
   

 ● Hands\-on experience with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or
   

 equivalent.
   

 ● Experience building or maintaining automation frameworks.
   

 ● Experience converting requirements and user stories into automated test scenarios.
   

 ● Experience running automation in unattended/CI environments.
   

 ● Strong debugging, problem\-solving and failure\-analysis skills.
   

 ● Experience with test management, defect tracking and triaging.
   

 ● Experience working in a startup, scale\-up or lean engineering environment.
   

 ● Strong sense of ownership and ability to execute independently.
   

 ● Experience with AI testing and quality engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools
   

 Nice to Have
   

 ● API testing and automation
   

 ● Accessibility testing
   

 ● Visual regression testing
   

 ● Performance/load testing
   

 ● Docker and Kubernetes
   

 ● CI/CD platforms
   

 ● Enterprise software and security\-focused environments
   

 How We Work
   

 We are a small, experienced and highly collaborative engineering team. Our size gives every
   

 engineer the opportunity to have a meaningful impact.
   

 We value:
   

 ● Ownership — Take a problem from understanding through implementation and outcomes.
   

 ● Initiative — We appreciate people who identify opportunities and proactively make things
   

 better.
   

 ● Independent execution — You will have autonomy to decide how to solve problems while
   

 having support when you need it.
   

 ● Engineering excellence — We care about building maintainable solutions, not just getting
   

 a test to pass once.
   

 ● Speed and pragmatism — We move quickly, learn quickly and continuously improve.
   

 Because we operate with a lean structure, you will have broad ownership and visibility into your
   

 work. You won't be limited to a narrowly defined QA function — you'll collaborate across
   

 Engineering and Product and have the opportunity to influence how we build quality into SBOX.

Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

title: API Automation Test Engineer
description:
**Position Overview** 




 The API Automation Tester will join the ITG – Personal Investors IT team (PI Germany) at BNP Paribas India Solutions, Chennai. The role is responsible for automating and maintaining artefacts and regression tests for mobile, web, and API‑driven applications across the Personal Investors business line. The tester will design, develop, and execute automated API tests, collaborate closely with developers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders, and ensure high‑quality software delivery.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 



* Develop, execute, and maintain automation test scripts using Selenium, Cucumber, and API‑testing tools, following the enterprise Automation Framework.
* Perform manual testing when needed, creating and maintaining test sets.
* Configure and run CI/CD jobs in GitLab, incorporating Nexus for artifact management.
* Assess automation feasibility for functional test cases and provide status updates to the Test Lead/Test Manager and the project team.
* Offer technical assistance to fellow Automation Engineers on the enterprise framework.
* Work collaboratively with QA, development, and other project members in an agile environment.



  





**Required Education, Skills, AND Experience (MUST‑HAVE)** 



* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent).
* Minimum 7 years of IT software QA/testing experience, with a strong focus on Selenium.
* At least 7 years of hands‑on API test‑automation experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in the BFSI domain (personal finance or lending experience is a plus).
* Proficient in Java and automation scripting for web, API, and mobile tools (Selenium, Appium, Cucumber).
* Demonstrated experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and artifact repositories (Nexus).
* Mandatory competence in JIRA‑XRay for test management.
* Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.



  





**Preferred Education, Skills, AND Experience (NICE‑TO‑HAVE)** 



* Direct experience with personal finance or lending applications within the BFSI sector.
* Advanced knowledge of mobile‑automation frameworks (e.g., Appium) beyond basic usage.
* Exposure to additional test‑automation tools or languages (e.g., RestAssured, Postman, Python).
* Certifications in test automation, Java development, or agile methodologies.
* Experience working in a fully remote or distributed delivery model.



  





**About BNP Paribas India Solutions** 




 BNP Paribas India Solutions, a wholly‑owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, operates 24 × 7 delivery centers in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai. With more than 10 000 professionals, we support the Group’s Corporate \& Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking businesses worldwide.
 



  





 BNP Paribas is an equal‑opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* A 15 years full time education is required.

 **Selenium\-based automation frameworks**

title: Test Development Engineer
description:
Rotork is the market\-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.
   

  

 Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Lead the development, execution, and maintenance of verification and validation strategies for complex embedded products.
   

  

 Architect, design, and enhance scalable test automation frameworks using LabVIEW and Python.
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end test lifecycle activities including test planning, test design, execution, defect analysis, and release sign A.
   

  

 Mentor and technically guide junior and mid\-level test engineers on best practices in test development and debugging.
   

  

 Drive root cause analysis of complex system\-level issues and work closely with design, firmware, and systems teams to resolve them.
   

  

 Define and enforce test standards, coding guidelines, and design patterns within the test organization.
   

  

 Perform advanced exploratory and stress testing to identify corner cases and systemic gaps.
   

  

 Review product requirements and specifications to proactively identify ambiguities, risks, and testability gaps. Develop comprehensive test plans, traceability matrices, and ensure complete requirement\-to\-test coverage.
   

  

* Actively participate in design reviews and contribute testability feedback early in the development cycle. Own and improve CI/CD integration for automated tests and test infrastructure. Lead defect triage discussions and influence prioritization based on risk and customer impact.


**Technical Skills:**
* Expert\-level experience in automated and manual testing of embedded systems, with strong specialization in LabVIEW. Deep understanding and practical application of LabVIEW design patterns and modular test architectures. Advanced proficiency in NI TestStand for complex test sequencing, reporting, and parallel execution. Strong experience with version control systems, branching strategies, code reviews, and change management.
* In\-depth knowledge of SDLC, STLC, and mature defect management processes. Extensive hands\-on experience with lab equipment such as: Multimeters, Loop calibrators, Digital storage oscilloscopes, Protocol analyzers
* Strong expertise in embedded systems testing and industrial communication protocols such as: CAN, Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet\-based industrial protocols


 Proven ability to design and implement custom test automation frameworks in Python.
   

  

 Experience with test data analysis, logging, and result visualization.
   

  

 Familiarity with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and system\-level test environments is a plus.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience:**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
   

  

 8–12 years of hands\-on experience in the embedded systems testing domain, with a strong emphasis on test automation, test development, and system level validation.
   

  

 Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level, NI CLD/CLA, or equivalent professional credentials are a plus.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision\-making skills with the ability to handle ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to collaborate Actively with global stakeholders and native English speakers.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership and mentoring capabilities.
   

  

 Ability to work independently while influencing cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

 Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect cosumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

title: Test Lead
description:

* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain domain experts to translate process requirements into testable scenarios that reflect real world production conditions and supplier constraints.

* Prepare clear test reports and quality dashboards that summarize execution status defect trends and release readiness so that project stakeholders can make informed go or no go decisions.

* Coordinate with project managers and architects to identify testing risks early propose mitigation strategies and adjust test plans when project scope or timelines evolve.


**Qualifications**

* Bring domain exposure in manufacturing and supply chain processes such as production execution material management quality tracking and traceability in order to design realistic and risk focused test scenarios.
* Utilize strong skills in defect management test management and collaboration tools along with clear communication capabilities to partner effectively with distributed cross functional teams in a hybrid work setup.
* Maintain a continuous learning mindset by staying current with advances in MES technologies automated testing frameworks and AI driven quality engineering practices relevant to the role.

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e\-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top\-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.
   

  

 You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item\-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1\-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross\-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross\-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code \& procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade\-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
   

  

 Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
   

  

 Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.
   

  

 Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.
   

  

 Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times
   

  

**About The Team**
 Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on\-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross\-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

title: BESS - SCADA Design and Testing Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 You will be a part of the Energy Storage \& Automation Engineering team and support the engineering, design, development, testing, and commissioning of SCADA systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Automation projects. Your work will primarily involve developing SCADA architecture, HMI/graphical screens, communication interfaces, databases, and remote monitoring solutions using industry\-standard tools such as Ignition SCADA, MicroSCADA, and PostgreSQL.
   

  

 You will be an individual contributor responsible for delivering engineering activities based on project requirements while coordinating closely with cross\-functional teams including Control \& Protection, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Project Management, and Commissioning teams. In the absence of your Lead Engineer, you may be required to interact directly with customers, vendors, and other stakeholders to resolve technical queries and ensure successful project execution.
   

  

 The role offers the opportunity to work on advanced energy automation solutions, integrating Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Inverters, Protection IEDs, PLCs, RTUs, and cloud\-based monitoring applications for utility\-scale projects.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Design and develop SCADA systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) automation applications.
* Develop and configure HMI/SCADA screens, dashboards, alarm management, trends, and reporting solutions using Ignition SCADA, MicroSCADA, and Zenon SCADA platforms.
* Configure and maintain PostgreSQL databases for historian data, alarm logs, event management, and operational reporting.
* Implement communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, OPC UA, DNP3, IEC 61850, MQTT, and REST APIs.
* Design and configure web\-based SCADA solutions enabling secure remote monitoring and control.
* Perform SCADA system integration, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and commissioning support activities.
* Configure alarms, trends, reports, historian functions, user management, and cybersecurity settings.
* Troubleshoot communication issues, SCADA performance problems, and field device integration challenges.
* Prepare technical documentation including system design documents, configuration manuals, testing procedures, and user guides.
* Collaborate effectively with Electrical Engineering, Control Software Development, Cybersecurity, Project Management, and Commissioning teams.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and project stakeholders during project execution.
* Adhere to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards, and specifications.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Must have 5\-10 years of experience in SCADA system design, development, integration, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience in utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Solar Plants, Substations, Power Systems, or Industrial Automation applications.
* Strong experience with Ignition SCADA, MicroSCADA, Zenon, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent SCADA platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL and other SQL databases for SCADA historian and reporting applications.
* Good understanding of Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Inverters, and power conversion systems.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, OPC UA, DNP3, IEC 61850, MQTT, and REST APIs.
* Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern HMI development frameworks is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with SCADA cybersecurity, secure communication practices, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
* Understanding of applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, ANSI, ISO, and utility communication standards.
* Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of SCADA systems.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global engineering environment.


 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required

We are transforming how data is governed by embedding automation, scalability, and modern data engineering practices into our governance model.
 


  

  


**The Role** 



  

  


 We are seeking highly motivated
 **Data Governance Engineers** 
 to join our Chennai\-based team. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building and scaling automated Data Governance capabilities across Pearson’s data ecosystem.
 


  

  


 This role is primarily an
 **engineering\-focused position (approximately 70–80% hands\-on engineering, 20–30% governance\-related work)** 
 . The expectation is that strong data engineers will apply their skills to governance\-focused use cases, while developing deeper expertise in data governance, metadata, and compliance domains over time.
 


  

  


 You will work closely with global Data Governance leadership, data engineering teams, and external partners to design and implement solutions that operationalize governance at scale. This role is critical to reducing manual effort for business stakeholders while improving data quality, compliance, and discoverability.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  


**Governance Engineering \& Automation** 



  

  
* Design and build automation solutions that operationalize Data Governance processes and reduce manual effort for Data Stewards.
  

  
* Translate governance policies into scalable, technical implementations embedded within data platforms (with guidance from senior team members as needed).
  

  
* Together with US\-based Data Governance team, develop reusable frameworks and patterns that enable consistent governance adoption across business units.
  


  


**Collibra Platform \& Integration** 



  

  
* Configure, extend, and support the Collibra Data Governance platform, including workflows and API\-based integrations.
  

  
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise data platforms to enable automated metadata ingestion, lineage, and governance workflows.
  

  
* Support enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage capabilities.
  


  


**Metadata \& Data Catalog Management** 



  

  
* Support the build\-out of integrations with data sources (e.g., RDBMS, data warehouses, data lakes, SaaS systems, PaaS systems) to support catalog ingestion.
  

  
* Enable automated data discovery, classification, and enrichment to improve usability and trust.
  

  
* Ensure metadata accuracy, completeness, and scalability across platforms.
  


  


**Data Quality Engineering** 



  

  
* Design and implement data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and validation pipelines as needed to support OCTO team and Pearson business units.
  

  
* Build and manage data quality jobs to support profiling, validation, and issue detection.
  

  
* Collaborate with Data Stewards to define quality standards and remediation workflows.
  


  


**Data Compliance, Security \& Privacy** 



  

  
* Implement governance controls for data classification, access management, and privacy compliance.
  

  
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise security and compliance tooling.
  

  
* Support initiatives related to regulatory and policy compliance requirements.
  


  


**Data Engineering \& Integration** 



  

  
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and integration services supporting governance use cases.
  

  
* Integrate data across platforms using ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering practices.
  

  
* Ensure pipelines align with governance standards for quality, lineage, and security.
  


  


**Collaboration \& Delivery** 



  

  
* Partner with global stakeholders and Data Governance leadership to deliver prioritized backlog items. Participate in stand\-up meetings with US\-based team, accept assignments from US team leads.
  

  
* Work closely with engineering teams and external partners (e.g., Deloitte) to industrialize governance solutions.
  

  
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for governance engineering.
  


  


**Qualifications** 



  

  


**Required (Core Engineering Skills)** 



  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related technical field.
  

  
* 3–6\+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or related roles.
  

  
* Strong programming and data engineering experience (e.g., Python, SQL).
  

  
* Hands\-on experience with APIs and system integrations (REST, microservices).
  

  
* Familiarity with modern cloud\-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks).
  


  


**Preferred (Data Governance \& Domain Experience – can be developed on the job)** 



  

  
* Understanding of data governance concepts including metadata, lineage, and data quality.
  

  
* Experience with data governance tools, preferably Collibra.
  

  
* Experience implementing data catalog, lineage, or metadata management solutions.
  

  
* Exposure to data quality frameworks and monitoring tools.
  

  
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance principles (e.g., PII, access controls).
  

  
* Experience designing and implementing data pipelines or integrating data from multiple sources.
  

  
* Experience working in global, cross\-functional teams.
  


  


**Skills \& Attributes** 



  

  
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
  

  
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  

  
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  

  
* Self\-starter with a focus on delivering scalable, high\-quality solutions.
  

  
* Interest in developing expertise in Data Governance and enterprise data management practices.
  

  
* Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  


  


**What We Offer** 



  

  
* Opportunity to contribute to a global, enterprise\-wide Data Governance transformation.
  

  
* Exposure to modern data platforms, tools, and engineering practices.
  

  
* Collaborative, inclusive, and growth\-oriented work environment.
  

  
* Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with local market standards.

**Expertise in .NET:**

* Extensive experience in developing scalable, high\-performance enterprise applications using .NET


**Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure/GCP):**

+ AWS: EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation

**Microservices Architecture:**
* Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using ASP.NET Core, with resilience libraries like Polly, and developing REST and GraphQL APIs
* Experience with inter\-service communication using Eventgrid,gRPC or Kafka


**Performance Optimization:**
* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like dotnet\-trace, dotnet\-counters, and Visual Studio's Diagnostic Tools
* Expertise in .NET runtime (CLR) performance tuning, memory management (garbage collection), and SQL query optimization


**DevOps Practices and CI/CD:**
* Hands\-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including:
+ CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure Pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, GCP Cloud Build
+ Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS)
+ Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible
+ Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk


**Database and Data Storage:**
* Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server)
* Experience with NoSQL and caching technologies and/or hyperscaler\-native options


**Code Reviews and Best Practices:**
* Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry\-standard best practices
* Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis


**API Management and Security:**
* Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway
* Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML


**System Architecture and Design:**
* Experience producing architecture/design artifacts (diagrams, decision logs) using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or ArchiMate
* Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event\-driven architectures, and domain\-driven design (DDD)


**Continuous Learning and Collaboration:**
* Commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in .NET and cloud\-native technologies
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure alignment and deliver high\-quality solutions

 Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering\-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

* At least 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault\-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud

+ Using Entity Framework Core (EF Core), including database connection pool configuration

description:

 We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Software Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in software design, development, and maintenance of enterprise\-grade applications. title: WLAN Performance Testing - Staff Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: Specialist, Software Technology
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
   

  

 The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

 KLA's eBeam Division is looking for passionate software developers to join us and help define and deliver high\-quality solutions for our current generation and next generation products in our Wafer Inspection and Review product lines. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be responsible to build software solutions for the machine control software of our products which would have a direct impact on the semi\-conductor manufacturing leading up to a better quality of life for all.
   

  

 You will fit right in if you have a good understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science. Are you somebody who enjoys working on complex software, is very keen on understanding customer use cases and enjoys, understands the big picture? You will work with exceptional talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups such as systems/hardware engineering, SMEs, manufacturing.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to learn, contribute and collaborate in developing end\-to\-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on learning and applying clean coding practices. Having a keen interest and ability to analyze problems and tackle them would be critical in this role.
   

  

 Knowledge of Object\-Oriented software analysis and design, Microsoft .Net or C\+\+ programming would also be important.
   

  

* Be responsible for the analysis of current software systems for performance, throughput, diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems and comping developing solutions that address these issues.
* Be responsible for developing prototypes and working on solutions for new concepts.
* Implement machine control software in accordance with functional use cases ensuring high performance and optimized hardware interactions.
* Incorporate sophisticated software algorithms for resource intensive software requirements to optimize and enhance performance of the hardware system. Good software documentation skills are required.
* Be willing to learn new design principles, technologies and business use\-cases is essential.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 KLA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.
   

  

 We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.
   

  

 KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data
